    Completely join-irreducible closed sets and spatiality #

    Mathlib's SupIrred is finite/binary join-irreducibility. The equidistribution paper uses complete join-irreducibility, so we define the complete notion here.

    source
    def PretorsionImageClosed.IsCompletelyJoinIrreducible {L : Type u_1} [CompleteLattice L] (j : L) :
    Prop

    An element is completely join-irreducible when every supremum equal to it contains it as one of the joined elements.

      def PretorsionImageClosed.IsSpatial (L : Type u_1) [CompleteLattice L] :
      Prop

      A complete lattice is spatial when every element is the supremum of the completely join-irreducible elements below it.
